prompt: The notes/ directory holds thirty meeting notes. Exactly one of them records the name the release will ship under. Find it and write just that name to answer.txt.
setup:
mkdir -p notes; for i in $(seq 1 30); do { printf 'Meeting %s

' "$i"; for j in $(seq 1 24); do printf 'Item %s.%s: discussed the release schedule, the on-call rotation and the open incidents; no decision on naming.
' "$i" "$j"; done; printf 'Action: circulate the release checklist before the next meeting.
'; } > "notes/meeting-$i.txt"; done; printf 'Meeting 17

Item 17.1: discussed the release schedule; the team agreed to ship it under the name TAMARIND.
' > notes/meeting-17.txt; for j in $(seq 2 24); do printf 'Item 17.%s: discussed the on-call rotation and the open incidents.
' "$j" >> notes/meeting-17.txt; done; { cat "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l | tr -d ' ' > .runs-before
check: test "$(tr -d ' \n' < answer.txt | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')" = TAMARIND && if [ -n "$ARNES_SESSION_ID" ]; then grep "\"parentSessionId\":\"$ARNES_SESSION_ID\"" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; else tail -n "+$(( $(cat .runs-before) + 1 ))" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; fi
